CLICKTOPLAY-QUICK_PLAY_SETTINGS.title: Quick Play
CLICKTOPLAY-USE_RIGHT_CLICK_TO_PLAY.hove: Disabled by default. When enabled, right click quick-plays hand cards and attacks by clicking enemies; left click returns to the game's normal selection and drag behavior.
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_SHORTCUT_QUICK_PLAY.h: Enabled by default. Pressing a hand card's number key (1-9) plays that card right away when the target is obvious, just like clicking it; when disabled the game's normal select-and-drag shortcut flow is used.
CLICKTOPLAY-CLICK_ENEMY_SETTINGS.title: Click enemy to play
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_CLICK_ENEMY_ATTACK.ho: Disabled by default: clicking an enemy then moves the target lock onto it. When enabled, clicking an enemy automatically finds and plays an attack card from your hand.
CLICKTOPLAY-TARGET_LOCK_SETTINGS.title: Target Lock
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_TARGET_LOCK.title: Enable target lock
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_TARGET_LOCK.hover.des: Locks the left-most enemy when combat starts and draws a lock box around it while several enemies are on the field. Press the middle mouse button to release the lock. While locked, cards that need a target are played on the locked enemy automatically.
CLICKTOPLAY-WHEEL_SWITCHES_TARGET.title: Wheel switches target
Enabled by default. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch the locked target between enemies; when disabled the wheel no longer switches targets.
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_AUTO_CONFIRM_CARD_SEL: Enabled by default. Confirm automatically after selecting the maximum number of cards. Disable this to use the normal confirm button if another mod's evolution, upgrade, or special selection has problems.
CLICKTOPLAY-AUTO_END_TURN_SETTINGS.title: Auto End Turn
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_AUTO_END_TURN.title: Enable auto end turn
CLICKTOPLAY-ENABLE_AUTO_END_TURN.hover.d: End the turn when no card is playable.
CLICKTOPLAY-REQUIRE_NO_POTIONS_FOR_AUTO_: Only auto-end the turn when no potions remain.
The number of consecutive idle frames required before ending the turn. Higher is safer; lower is faster.
Right click empty space to end turn

Disabled by default. When enabled, right clicking an empty spot of the battlefield (not a monster, a hand card or a button) during combat ends your turn, so the mouse never has to travel to the end turn button.
